environment.working_tree: untracked ERP implementation docs; no production code changes

decisions.summary: Products is the user-facing master; preserve legacy catalog IDs and CRM entity references.
Organization scope and actor authority derive from authenticated context.
New logical contracts use the conceptual product model; legacy type conversion remains explicit and unresolved.
Mutations use expectedVersion and idempotency metadata where duplicate effects are possible.
Lists are bounded and stably paginated; exact cursor contract remains open.
Category management is a first-class logical query/command surface within Products.
Offer and pricing APIs remain compatibility contracts pending ownership and sensitivity decisions.
Party role, availability and eligibility are not promised remotely until domain/persistence ownership is resolved.
Product/category events are proposals only; no event infrastructure or consumer contract is implemented.
Remote mutation remains blocked by access-model RLS and permission-key gaps.
Transport and canonical routes are unresolved; organization-wide product/category scope is confirmed.

actions: Mapped Products queries and commands from discovery, domain and current adapter contracts.
Defined request/response boundaries, validation and error/retry semantics.
Recorded pagination, optimistic concurrency, idempotency and consistency assumptions.
Specified proposed event payload boundaries and shared Platform/CRM compatibility.
Kept transport, infrastructure, implementation and endpoint naming open.

requirements.evidence: Logical product contracts are recorded; legacy type mapping, catalog grouping, versioning and remote access gaps remain open.
Category commands and error boundaries are documented; category scope, lifecycle and uniqueness are unresolved.
Existing catalog_item entity references and CRM-owned customer identity remain compatible; no duplicate customer API is proposed.

evidence.result: Documents logical commands/queries, DTO boundaries, errors, pagination, concurrency, events, consumers and platform impact.
Current adapter exposes unpaged arrays, legacy CRUD and catalog_item reference resolution; no category API exists.
Remote adapter maps catalog rows but has no version/idempotency fields and returns empty remote party-role, availability and eligibility lists.
